text:
marisa: Heads-up — customer reported a big billing spike + latency regressions after yesterday's OpenAPI change. They say SDK clients (py/ts/go) started hammering retries and we see a bunch of duplicate /v1/generate calls. full ticket: #7219 :grimacing:
sam: Can you paste an example log or curl they used? 401 vs 429?
marisa: Here are snippets they pasted:
```
2026-03-14T15:02:11Z ERROR request failed status=401 body={"error":"invalid_api_key"} request_id=abc123
2026-03-14T15:02:11Z RETRY enqueue id=abc123 reason=status_401
2026-03-14T15:02:12Z INFO request sent id=abc123 status=200
```
They claim client retried on 401, not just 429. Also seeing `x-request-id` header being normalized differently between SDKs.
aleks: That sounds like a generated-client regression — our new OpenAPI spec renamed `x-request-id` -> `X-Request-Id` in the header param, and openapi-generator produced subtly different behaviour across languages. Some clients lower-case headers and treat 401 as retryable because of a config mismatch.
isaac: Do we have an example minimal repro? dev wrote a short repro in the ticket:
```
# ts repro
const r = await client.generate({model: 'rwd-base', input: 'hi'}).catch(e => console.log(e));
// logs: 401, then retry -> 200 (duplicate charge)
```
natalie: CI flagged regen PR earlier (PR #4789) but it was merged without updating changelogs for retry policy changes. ci-bot: (deploy bot) merged 4789 at 2026-03-13 22:45 :gear:
ci-bot: New generated clients: python 0.12.3, typescript 0.7.9, go 0.3.2 — tests passed but flaky auth unit failed 2/5 times. :eyes:
sam: Ok actionable checklist: (1) confirm openapi diff, (2) reproduce locally with each SDK, (3) rollback client or patch retry rules, (4) notify support + customer credits if billing spike confirmed. I'll take (1) and (2).
marisa: assigning to sam + aleks to verify cross-sdk behaviour. Also ping @security if this looks like an auth surface change.
aleks: quick diff I ran: header param changed from:
```
parameters:
  - name: x-request-id
    in: header
    required: false
```
to:
```
parameters:
  - name: X-Request-Id
    in: header
    required: false
```
openapi-generator produced client code that sometimes adds a default retry for 401 when header missing — because generator templating defaulted retryOn= ['5xx','401'] for some languages after the param rename.
isaac: Repro steps I used for python:
```
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/openapi-clients.git
cd python-client
git checkout regen/2026-03-13
pip install -e .[dev]
python examples/repro_retry_401.py
```
example logs show `requests` raising 401, sdk wrapper auto-retries due to retry policy in generated `config.py`:
```
# generated config snippet
RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES = [401, 429, 502, 503]
```
marisa: That config change is the root. Why was 401 considered retryable? We only want 429/5xx by default.
aleks: The generator has a mapping that toggles when header params are present/absent. This was an accidental side-effect of a template improvement for header casing. Will open PR to change generated default to exclude 401.
sam: Meanwhile, we should patch hosted runtime to short-circuit client-side retries for repeated identical request_ids (dedupe). If the header is missing we should treat requests as non-idempotent — avoid automatic retry billing. Ops/infra: could we add a server-side idempotency/sniffer?
devex-bot: Created issue infra#1191 for server-side dedupe and linked ticket #7219.
natalie: For customers impacted, propose refund for duplicate tokens + patch release and patch notes. Also need a hotfix release for python/ts clients.
marisa: Who will raise the hotfix PRs? sam, can you coordinate with SDK owners?
sam: Yep. I'll prepare regenerate clients with corrected templates and update changelog. Plan: cut hotfix python 0.12.4 / ts 0.7.10 / go 0.3.3. ETA EOD PST.
aleks: Also adding unit test that asserts `RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES` excludes 401 by default and an integration test simulating 401->200 sequence without billing duplication.
isaac: FYI the support engineer mentioned user had pinned the TS client to 0.7.9 and the Python to 0.12.3 — both affected. We'll include remediation steps in support reply: downgrade to pre-regen version or apply patch wheel.
marisa: Great. Also update the changelog entry to explicitly call out retry semantics change so customers see it. Add an internal note to prevent merging regenerations without verifying retry policy.
sam: Opening PRs now: python draft: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/812, ts draft: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/614.
marisa: Thanks team. Keep updates in the ticket and paste any customer-facing text here before sending. :thumbsup:
